name: seal_manifest
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
lane=Path.cwd(); excluded=['manifest.json','seal_manifest.receipt.json','seal_manifest.output.txt']; files=[]
for p in sorted(lane.rglob('*')):
 assert not p.is_symlink(),str(p)
 if p.is_file() and str(p.relative_to(lane)) not in excluded:
  b=p.read_bytes(); files.append({'path':str(p.relative_to(lane)),'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
assert json.loads(Path('frozen-after.json').read_text())['mismatches']==[]
assert len(json.loads(Path('results.json').read_text()))==20
budget=json.loads(Path('search-budget.json').read_text()); assert budget['calls_used']==3 and budget['queries_used']==9
m={'kind':'exhaustive own-lane terminal seal','files':files,'terminal_noncircular_self_exclusions':excluded,'frozen_after':'13 bindings no mismatches','qualified_survivors':0,'author_full_ordinary_proposals':[362896],'credit':0,'no_further_work':True}
s=json.dumps(m,indent=2)+'\n'; r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'manifest.json'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True); assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
for e in files: assert hashlib.sha256((lane/e['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==e['sha256']
print(json.dumps({'sealed_files':len(files),'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest(),'excluded':excluded,'frozen_bindings':13,'mismatches':[],'qualified_survivors':0,'full_author_ordinary_proposal':362896,'scientific_status':'HOLD','credit':0}))
